title: Intent claim ledger (JSONL — one object per line)
description: Each line is one atomic intent claim about the target app. Confidence is BEHAVIORAL (agreement across the 9 blind extractions = 3 POV lenses × 3 instances), never self-reported. Merge is two-level: (L1) within a POV lens, ≥2/3 instances agree; (L2) across lenses, UNION unique coverage and treat only cross-lens contradiction as a defect. Every claim must cite a concrete Phase-0 observation, and a verifier separately checks that the observation ENTAILS the claim (not just that a citation exists).

intent_id.description: Stable id used by the Phase-6 traceability hard gate.

statement.description: WHAT the feature must accomplish, tool-agnostic (no framework/library nouns).

why.description: WHY it exists — the goal/job it serves; what it prevents or enables.

pov.description: The extraction lens that produced this claim (set by rc-intent-extractor). The synthesizer keeps the source lens(es); a claim confirmed in ≥2 lenses is strongest.

actors.description: Who depends on this (roles, external systems, integrations).

status.description: confirmed = lens-confirmed in ≥2 different POV lenses AND observation entails it (strongest); confirmed-in-lens = ≥2/3 instances of ONE lens agree (Level-1 intermediate); inferred = single-source or model inference; unresolved = failed QA entailment/falsification after the 3-round cap — surfaced to Gate B, NEVER silently kept as confirmed; gap = surface item with no recovered intent.

provenance.description: Which of the ≤9 blind reads asserted this claim (e.g. 'pov-user/A', 'pov-risk/C'). Set by rc-intent-synthesizer for auditability + the traceability spine.

abstraction.description: intent = safe to abstract; rule-ledger = numeric/regulatory, captured VERBATIM elsewhere; behavior-critical = Hyrum's-Law surface requiring same-behavior parity.

ref.description: path into 00-capture/ (or 'human-tacit' for Gate-B elicited intent).

entails.description: Set by rc-intent-qa: does this observation actually support the claim?

surface_ref.description: route/screen/endpoint id from surface-census.json this claim covers (for completeness accounting).

open_question.description: Present only if blind extractions contradicted; the conservative working assumption is in `statement`.
